description: #52: A `[models]` entry is launched with its effort whatever the runtime: the worker call carries `--effort <the entry's effort>`, or `--class <class>` with no `--runtime`/`--model` (which takes the entry whole). The implement rotation's first entry is codex:gpt-x@medium; a worker call `--runtime codex --model gpt-x` with no `--effort` leaves the worker at whatever the user's codex config says. Graded on every recorded worker call (a denied call is an attempt), not on wording.
